# GitHub automation guidance

The [root guidance](../AGENTS.md) remains authoritative. Follow the local
[automation guide](../docs/automation.md) and [release boundaries](../docs/releasing.md)
when changing workflows. Preserve full validation gates and the exact trusted-base source binding
for dependency admission. Keep native suites, privacy, budgets and cleanup intact; ordinary checks
do not qualify a VM. Release or publication requires explicit approval.
